title: rbac-v2: enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging enhancements
author: Priya Raman
release_notes: Enforces RBAC v2 KMS region pinning for customer-managed keys and improves audit logging for residency decisions. No customer-facing API changes; operators must update config and migration scripts.
description: Motivation: Customers with strict data residency requirements and KMS-managed keys need deterministic enforcement that service components cannot bypass. This PR completes RBAC v2 integration with KMS region pinning and improves audit logging so residency decisions are observable. Changes: 1) Add enforcement hook in rbac-v2 middleware to validate KMS key region against the resource region/policy and fail-safe to deny when mismatched. 2) Emit structured audit events for KMS selection, policy evaluation (allow/deny/policy-mismatch), and fallback behavior. 3) Config knobs: rbac.v2.kms_enforce=true/false and rbac.v2.kms_audit_level={info,debug,strict}. 4) Migration: add a one-time job that backfills audits for existing keys and flags keys without region metadata. 5) E2E tests and unit coverage for policy permutations. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (ENG-2148) - [x] Add enforcement middleware and unit tests - [x] Structured audit events (JSON) emitted to audit-log stream - [x] Migration/backfill job + safety gating flag - [x] Integration tests in perf-canary - [x] Manual QA on staging with private deployment - [x] Update operator docs and config templates Rollout: feature flag gated by rbac.v2.kms_enforce (default: false) and staged rollout to Dedicated then Private, with monitoring on audit event rates and auth failures. Related: SUP-1182 (customer support case for key-residency mismatch). Notes: this PR intentionally does not alter the default behavior (enforcement off) to avoid surprises; turning enforcement on requires coordination with SRE/ES for key metadata completeness.
commits: 4 commits: 1) add rbac v2 kms enforcement hook and unit tests; 2) structured audit event schema + emitter; 3) migration/backfill job + safety flag; 4) docs and operator config updates
review_comments: Marcus: requested clearer error codes for policy mismatch and suggested adding a telemetry counter for 'policy_mismatch' failures. Elena: flagged a race in migration where keys added during backfill could be missed; suggested use of consistent pagination and an idempotency token. Samir: asked for a safety gating flag and explicit operator runbook — added. SRE Bot: initial CI flake on integration test; re-ran and passed. Author replies: clarified error codes, fixed pagination logic in migration, and added docs for rolling back the flag.
ci_details: CI matrix: unit (pass), lint (pass), integration (flaky -> rerun -> pass), e2e (pass on canary). Notable: integration timeout hit on first run due to test infra slowness; retried with extended timeout. No security scans flagged new issues.
migration_instructions: Run: ./bin/redwood-migrate backfill-kms-regions --dry-run then without --dry-run. Ensure rbac.v2.kms_audit_level=info during backfill to avoid verbose logs. Coordinate with SRE to enable rbac.v2.kms_enforce=false->true in rollout window. If keys are missing region metadata, see docs/operator/kms-region-pinning.md for remediation steps.
operational_impact: When enforcement is enabled, API calls using KMS keys with mismatched regions will be denied with 403 and an explicit error code 'KMS_REGION_PINNING_VIOLATION'. Audit events emitted for every decision will increase audit-log volume; estimate +0.5-2% depending on workload. Added dashboards and alerts to monitor spike in 'KMS_REGION_PINNING_VIOLATION' and audit-event backlog.
tester_notes: Staging run: ran canary workload for 48h with enforcement off and audit_level=debug to validate emitter; observed expected structured events. Once enforcement is toggled in Dedicated, run canary for 24h with small traffic, validate no unexpected 403s.
